headline: Bellingham brace guides England to World Cup semis after 2-1 extra-time victory over Norway
summary: Jude Bellingham scored twice, including the winner in extra time, as England defeated Norway 2-1 to secure their place in the FIFA World Cup semifinals.
details: England has booked their spot in the FIFA World Cup semifinals, overcoming Norway with a 2-1 extra-time victory at Miami Stadium. Midfielder Jude Bellingham was the hero, scoring both goals for the Three Lions.

Norway initially took the lead in the 36th minute with a powerful strike from Andreas Schjelderup. However, Bellingham quickly responded, restoring parity in first-half added time with a well-placed shot.

The decisive goal came in the first half of extra time when Bellingham reacted quickest to a rebound, securing England's progression. This brace brought his tournament tally to six goals, making him England's joint-leading scorer alongside Harry Kane.
England will now prepare to face either Argentina or Switzerland in the highly anticipated semi-finals, continuing their quest for the World Cup title.

headline_marked: [[Argentina unchanged for quarterfinal]] against Switzerland, coach Scaloni confirms
headline: Argentina unchanged for quarterfinal against Switzerland, coach Scaloni confirms
summary: Argentina will field the same starting XI that beat Egypt, while Switzerland makes one change and misses their leading scorer due to injury.
details: Argentina is set to face Switzerland in the World Cup quarter-final on Saturday, maintaining the same starting lineup that secured a 3-2 victory over Egypt in the last 16. Striker Julian Alvarez and midfielder Leandro Paredes will retain their positions.

Argentina coach Lionel Scaloni confirmed on Friday that he planned to start with a "very similar team to the other match." This decision emphasizes continuity and confidence in the squad's recent performance.

Switzerland manager Murat Yakin will make one change from the side that overcame Colombia on penalties after a goalless draw, with midfielder Djibril Sow replacing Ardon Jashari. Switzerland's leading scorer, Johan Manzambi, will miss the match again due to a knee injury that also sidelined him against Colombia.

The confirmed lineup for Argentina includes Emiliano Martinez; Nahuel Molina, Cristian Romero, Lisandro Martinez, Nicolas Tagliafico; Leandro Paredes, Rodrigo De Paul, Enzo Fernandez, Alexis Mac Allister; Lionel Messi, Julian Alvarez. For Switzerland, the lineup is Gregor Kobel; Denis Zakaria, Manuel Akanji, Nico Elvedi, Ricardo Rodriguez; Granit Xhaka, Remo Freuler, Djibril Sow; Fabian Rieder, Dan Ndoye, Breel Embolo.
caption:
